name: Izumi Hana
source:
Izumi Saki’s older sister, a beauty who gives the impression she could have any man she wanted wrapped around her finger. Has a free-spirited personality and has a huge brother complex. She shows up at the school’s cultural festival.

[Source: [url=https://tarhs.booth.pm/items/1269]preview booklet[/url]]
